description:
In the demodb database, create a custom security role and user account for a new data analyst.

Step 1: Create a new role named 'data_analyst' that inherits from the built-in 'reader' role. The role mode should be 0 (deny-all-but). Since it inherits from 'reader', it will have read access to all existing data.

Step 2: Grant CREATE permission on the resource 'database.class' to the 'data_analyst' role (so the analyst can create new classes).

Step 3: Grant CREATE permission on the resource 'database.cluster' to the 'data_analyst' role.

Step 4: Create a new database user named 'maria_garcia' with password 'Analyst2024!' and status 'ACTIVE', assigned to the 'data_analyst' role.

You can accomplish this through OrientDB Studio's SQL console (Browse > Query) or the Security management panel. Connect to the demodb database using admin/admin or root/GymAnything123! credentials.

After completing the task, the user maria_garcia should be able to authenticate to the demodb database and read data from existing classes like Hotels.
